messages:
Sam (AE): Morning async — quick standup: yesterday synced with MerchantHealth; legal is OK but they're waiting on formal KMS/HSM integration docs from us. Blocker: engineering asked for a network diagram and required port list. Today: prepping Cornerstone demo and chasing SOC2 artifacts. @Jordan (Sales Eng) any update on the HSM playbook? :wave:
Jordan (Sales Eng): I uploaded an initial HSM checklist to the sales drive (https://drive.redwood/handbook/hsm-checklist). Engineering needs to confirm ports + agent footprint. I'll loop in Eng infra. ETA EOD for a first draft. :memo:
Casey (Solutions): Heads-up — Legal is asking for explicit key residency wording for EU customers. Maria, can you confirm acceptable phrasing? Also drafting an addendum template we can reuse.
Maria (CISO): Confirmed — we can support EU key residency on Dedicated/Private. Need to decide whether we recommend CloudKMS or customer-managed HSM per contract. I'll DM Sam for exact contract language. For network diagram, minimal snippet: `allowed_ports: [443, 10250]` and `egress: required` — will add to the checklist.
Alex (AE): Quick flag for Kestrel deal — they need SOC2 Type II and a signed data-retention addendum before procurement. I've uploaded the redacted SOC2 to the portal. @Casey can you prepare the addendum template and a short cover note?
Casey (Solutions): On it. Also FYI for on-prem installs: typical timeline for air-gapped customer is ~4–6 weeks for validation + install. Recommend we set that expectation in the SOW.
Sam (AE): Thanks. Another blocker: demo requires v1.12 that includes the new LZC quantization. Can someone ping eng-release for ETA? @DeployBot any status?
DeployBot: Release v1.12 scheduled 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC. Known risk: potential beam-search regression with long sequences — see PR #8346. Link: https://git.internal/release/8346 
Jordan (Sales Eng): I'll caveat the demo. Also quick CR ping for @Priya (Eng) — PR #9123 adds customer-specific model hooks; need review before demo.
Priya (Eng): Reviewing PR #9123 now. Found a minor lint and one batching perf concern under large concurrent streams. Commented on PR with suggested changes. ETA for re-review: tomorrow morning.
Sam (AE): Perfect — summary for me: blockers are KMS/HSM doc + SOC2 addendum. I'll follow up with Maria + Casey, and I'll put a caveat on the Cornerstone demo about v1.12 risk. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Jordan (Sales Eng): +1. If anyone needs me to join a call with customer security, I can dial in this afternoon.
Casey (Solutions): I'll draft the addendum and post the first version here when ready.
Maria (CISO): I'll send the contract wording and a short FAQ about key residency & HSM options.
Priya (Eng): Ping me once the customer test matrix is available — I'll re-run perf checks after the PR land.
Sam (AE): Closing out — I'll update the deal notes and next steps in Hub (deal: TRAD-119).
